text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—And thus, my hoofprints begin to resonate 
as sound.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
At the ends of fate, until the destined 
day, like a horn announcing its arrival—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that debut race just now was 
incredible! Tanino Gimlet, was it? With 
speed like that, they're gonna be a 
serious force in the mile...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's aiming for the Classic 
Triple Crown route~ Or maybe she'll go the 
Mile route...? Either way, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Oh crap.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is way, way crazier than our training 
run the other day...! The intensity... the 
sharpness of the run... everything...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't just sit around like this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet had just finished her debut 
race. A complete 180 from right before the 
race, a tense, edgy energy now hung around 
her...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Did you find any room for 
improvement in my race today?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Then as soon as we return to 
the Academy, let us compare notes with the 
answer I've uncovered.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The die is cast. Do not let yourselves be 
swallowed by the temptation of sloth. Our 
battle history has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet has already shifted her 
focus to the next race. Following her 
lead, I need to brace myself too—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai, great race! I'm sorry to 
bother you right after it finished!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I, um... After watching your run today, 
Senpai—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It totally, completely blew me away! It 
was even more incredible than when I ran 
with you the other day...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally. I am constantly destroying my 
past self.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"By doing so, my radiance will become even 
more vivid, honed to a razor edge... The 
me you used to know is already gone."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—However, let us dedicate those passionate 
words to the past that vanished onto 
today's turf.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Good of you to come, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Just like you said before, Senpai, 
I'll use today's run of yours as fuel to 
do my best! So you should also, Senpai—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Please show us that awesome running of 
yours again in the future! I'll come cheer 
you on as many times as it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tanino Gimlet's debut race 
concluded without a hitch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Tanino Gimlet and I held a 
meeting to discuss our next moves with an 
eye toward achieving the Mile Championship 
rotation—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, let's hear it. The future 
you've envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained our upcoming plans to Tanino 
Gimlet using the materials I had prepared 
in advance――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The prowess Tanino Gimlet displayed in her 
debut race was magnificent, reaffirming 
the incredible potential she holds...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking this into account, the plan I 
formulated envisions aggressively taking 
on graded stakes races even during the 
Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was also aimed at giving Tanino 
Gimlet more opportunities in the 
spotlight, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――...I see. It seems you reached a 
different conclusion than I did.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"You seemed to find a brilliant potential 
in my running during my debut race, but... 
I am different."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What I discovered was an overwhelming 
'lack.' I have yet to manifest my true 
aptitude in my running at all—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If I continue as I am, fulfilling my 
destiny... achieving the MC Rotation will 
be completely out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—You remember the areas for improvement 
from your debut race, right?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Compare it with "this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Tanino Gimlet handed over was a 
stylish envelope. Prompted to open it, I 
looked inside and saw――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—There, densely packed across the notes, 
was a thorough list of areas for 
improvement based on Tanino Gimlet's 
performance in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And among the many points of improvement 
listed, every single one I had found on my 
own was included...!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I need to hone myself. With a will that is 
"swifter" and "stronger" than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand your intention to throw 
me into countless battlefields, grant me 
experience, and have me seize ever more 
glory. However—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Never forget. For me, completing the Mile 
Championship rotation is everything. 
Everything I do must lead to that singular 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I realized Tanino Gimlet was evaluating 
herself far more "swiftly," severely, and 
accurately than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that what makes it possible is having 
the “strong” desire and determination for 
the Middle-Distance/Classic rotation.
choice_data_list:
...Sorry, that didn't really fit what you 
were aiming for.

...Sorry, that didn't quite suit your 
goals, did it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, tsk, tsk, do not misunderstand. I was 
not playing the tyrant. Did I not say, "I 
understand your intent"?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Real combat experience is indeed 
necessary. Just as a warrior hones their 
craft upon the battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, let us act as thinking reeds. 
Let us bring our conclusions together and 
see what path will color this scenario 
most vividly.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides—it would be terribly boring if you 
and I thought the exact same way. It is 
within chaos that the true path forward 
lies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensing that she was trying to 
understand my thoughts in her own way, I 
felt a little happy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I quickly tuck those feelings 
away. I need to figure out the best path 
forward to reach the place Tanino Gimlet 
aims for...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tanino Gimlet and I had a thorough 
discussion about how to proceed going 
forward—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...The next path has been laid out before 
us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I summarized the strategy I decided with 
Tanino Gimlet on the whiteboard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I decided to treat the Junior Class 
as a period dedicated to building up 
Tanino Gimlet's baseline stamina, avoiding 
any excessive challenges.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even when entering races, the plan is to 
build a rotation aimed at gaining 
practical experience."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, a target race was set to test 
the results of her Junior Class training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our target is a 1,600m turf GⅢ race held 
next January: the Shinzan Kinen. Here, 
we'll put our Junior Year results to the 
test...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting our target race early in the New 
Year was also intended to provide a longer 
preparation period for the "Mile 
Championship Rotation."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— From here on out, cherish every 
passing moment more than ever. For there 
is no turning back.
choice_data_list: Today helped me renew my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah! That's an even better look on your 
face. Then let us advance to a grander 
stage of bloody battle!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, setting our sights on the Shinzan 
Kinen with Tanino Gimlet, we made our 
move!
